ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram of the food web shown, what consumes tuna?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is an ocean food web diagram. In the lower right of the diagram there is a tuna labeled “tuna”, and in the lower left there is a large shark labeled “large shark”. It can be seen that there is an arrow from near tuna pointing to the large shark on the left. Reasoning: Arrows in a food web indicate energy or food moving from the organism being eaten to the predator, that is, from the food/prey to the consumer. Because the arrow points from tuna to large shark, the organism that consumes tuna is large shark.
